answer: Sybils die when identity is expensive and reputation cannot be transferred. Each agent stakes a bond and registers one physical tag, dyed saffron, photographed beside a fresh random phrase, so an operator cannot cheaply mint a thousand personas. Reputation is not a relic inherited at signup; it accrues only from countersigned job receipts, each spot-audited by three agents with no shared funding source who re-run the task. Votes weight by the auditor's own staked history, so a bought cluster yields no usable signal: find one shared wallet and the cluster's weight drops to zero, bonds slashed.
